fusions.name: Shared Pasture
fusions.desc: Spits a mouthful of cud that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Barn-Warm Lowing
fusions.desc: Lows a warm cone 5 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it and leaving each [Damped] for 8 seconds. On a hit, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Huddle Close
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Long Winter Barn
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
